**Digest 2026-10-13 UTC** · CD Tracker (67 rows) · since 2026-10-11

**Summary**
• RQ-10..14: knowledge from names alone measured (900 pre-registered requests). The model orders 69% of true edges correctly from real names (12% contradicted), follows moved labels against the data, and says nothing with neutral names. Its tiers alone score 0.448, below data-only GES (0.528).
• CAP-04 / BLD-04: unblocked. Used only to orient connections the data found, the model's tiers lift GES from 0.528 to 0.546; wrong tiers cost 0.19, a bounded loss. Recording the source of every direction is what makes that loss detectable.
• TGT-17: the second public benchmark (Bayesys) also releases some graphs with columns in causal order; an earlier-column tie-break is worth up to +0.30 there. Claims about its published numbers wait on one reproduction check.
• RQ-05 / RQ-17: the four-agent name-reliance audit and Causal-Copilot on a second model are running now.
• CAP-08 / CAP-09: public market research done (market map and three verticals). Buyers already pay for root-cause answers, marketing measurement and real-world evidence; no vendor publishes per-claim provenance with calibrated confidence and an abstention rate. Best place to start: auditing the root-cause claims of AI incident agents.
• CAP-08: public evidence that people want AI analysis to show its work is broad; evidence that they would accept a tool that declines to answer does not exist yet.
• BLD-10: the project site is easier to read on phones and no longer leads with dates; a guided multi-page version is designed and waits on approval.

• ✅ CAP-17 Scoreboard packaging (CPDAG->DAG rule, summary.csv, validator)
• ✅ DOM-14 Theoretical baselines
• ✅ REP-09 Replicate Causal Chambers baselines

• ✅ RQ-11 With neutral names, does the model supply no order information at all?
• ✅ RQ-12 With names moved onto other columns, does the model's ordering follow the labels instead…
• ✅ RQ-13 Does regression on the model's ordering reach the best published 0.634 on CausalArena's…
• ✅ RQ-14 Does the same reach the best published 0.524 on the formula family?

**Started** (2)

• 👀 CAP-10 Robustness to malformed model output
